description: The shared rules (digest pinning, the 14-day minimumReleaseAge with timestamp-optional, and the managers for the mise version in workflows and for [tool.uv] build-constraint-dependencies) come from the iglootools presets, pinned to a release tag: see guidelines/project-setup/dependency-automation.md in iglootools/common. What is here is photree's own.

packageRules.description: Hold Python on 3.14, the documented exception next to requires-python in pyproject.toml (python-tooling.md in iglootools/common, "When a dependency lags"): onnxruntime (face-detection stack) publishes no cp315 wheels, so uv lock cannot resolve on 3.15. Matched by depName, which is python for both the mise [tools] pin and requires-python; the package name differs (python/cpython for mise), so matchPackageNames would miss the mise pin. Remove this rule when onnxruntime ships cp315 wheels and the project moves to 3.15.
